fields.label: Primary Section
fields.description: Which section this job tries first. Blank: the primary AI provider of the settings.

fields.label: Fallback
fields.description: Whether this job may move to the other section when its first one fails. Blank: as the settings say (Failover).

fields.label: Model
fields.description: From the allowed models of any provider. With a model set, the job ignores the sections and their fallback.

fields.label: Backup
fields.description: Answers only when the model's provider can't (an outage), never when a monthly limit is used up.
